input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Client. Section 2(a) grants only a non-exclusive licence and expressly confirms that Client "is not obligated to utilize the License and is free to acquire, develop, license or otherwise utilize any other" comparable software or services (subject only to not infringing TrueLink IP and to the Section 10 confidentiality obligations) — that is the preferred position. Section 8 contains no restrictive covenant on Client, and the only exclusivity-flavoured language elsewhere (the non-exclusive licence of Credit Data in 8(d) and the "solely and exclusively" forum wording in Section 12) does not restrict Client's sourcing freedom. We note but do not flag Section 3(i), which requires Client to order a credit report from TrueLink for each borrower where underwriting approval is requested through a System using the Interface: that is a narrow condition on use of TrueLink's own Interface rather than a requirements or sole-supplier commitment, and Client remains free not to use the Interface at all. The cross-referenced Non-Competition Agreement is a separate document outside this review.
